posts.title: Measuring the Atmosphere from Inside the Moon's Shadow
posts.description: A total solar eclipse and its lunar shadow over Valencia de Don Juan turn a panorama into an experiment on the height and cooling of the atmosphere.

posts.title: Modeling the COVID-19 / Coronavirus pandemic – 4.Modeling with at time variable infection rate.
posts.description: One of the most interesting aspects of the coronavirus is the time dependence of its infection rate. It determines how effective measures like quarantining can be. Spoiler: quite ineffective!

posts.title: Modeling the COVID-19 / Coronavirus pandemic – 3.The effects of several populations
posts.description: The next interesting question to ask when studying the coronavirus, is what is the effect of a mixed population which has different infection rates. That is, that some individuals are more infectious than others (e.g., a cashier in the supermarket vs. a farmer). Spoiler: it turns out that unless there are super-spreaders then all you care about is the arithmetic average of the transmission coefficient.
